rules: Independent seeded noise per case/trial. Full-field edges and sinusoids; normal angle0..90 step15 degrees, normal offset0/.5pixel, sinusoid periods4/8/16pixels, peak amplitudes2/6 marginal sigma. Whole128 and central31 use SAME observation, hence dependent. MAD Gaussian normalization; Haar HH sigma converted by KNOWN generating covariance transfer1 or1/3. No truth-based sample exclusion, no estimator selection or fitting.
limitations: Deliberate dense-structure stress test, not natural scene prevalence or production validation. Whole versus central support differs in Haar block phase and sample count. Known covariance oracle, not blind correction. Finite16 trials, no confidence claims. No filter or SURE risks measured; no RAW read.
